notes.title: Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
Exciting Update from Subcrew! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977908/395ff3026042d100fcaa5eb49b4a90e8a4c375cd.png[/img]

Thank you all for your support for Subcrew! I'm currently transitioning the game from Unity to Unreal Engine to deliver even more immersive graphics and seamless crossplay functions.

While this transition may add a bit of time, the goal is a release this autumn. Stay tuned for more updates as we dive towards an unforgettable gaming experience together!

// Rollergoose
